# SHA-256 manifest for vendored third-party sources (plan 03-02).
#
# One line per source tarball: sha256, tarball filename, version.
# Origin URLs and cross-check status for every entry live in vendor/README.md.
# Cross-check policy (03-02 threat model T-03-03/T-03-04): every hash below was
# compared against a value published by the upstream publisher at download
# time; entries that could NOT be cross-checked are explicitly flagged in
# vendor/README.md and never silently trusted.
#
# Re-verify offline against a re-downloaded tarball:
#   curl -O <origin URL from vendor/README.md>
#   sha256sum <tarball>   # must equal the hash recorded here
